Deck Name: Ian Forestall Allies
Author: Brandon Haas
Description: Ian's five disciplines of fury! SOmeone must have thought of the Nocturns + Shamblers combo before; I finally got around to building the deck. Ian comes out and burns blood on Nocturns, Governs, and Shamblers, among other things. He descends into darkness to refill and does it again. Oust with Anarch Revolts, Fame, and bleeding.

2x Elena Mendoza Vasquez 6 dom obt AUS THA !Tremere:3
